description.text: Pediatrics is a medical branch that studies the growth and development of children from the fetus to adolescence, disease prevention, diagnosis and treatment, with the core goal of "ensuring children's health and preventing and treating pediatric diseases". Compared with adult medicine, pediatrics not only focuses on the diseases themselves, but also emphasizes the physiological and psychological characteristics of children at different growth stages as well as the influence of the social environment. It needs to provide targeted medical care in combination with the anatomical and physiological differences of children, the particularity of their immune mechanisms and their developmental needs. Its scope covers the health management of newborns, infants, school-age children and adolescents, and it is an important discipline with high professionalism and humanistic care in clinical medicine.

duration.text: The Pediatrics at Xi'an Jiaotong University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.
